changes.title: Guidance pins
items: In the treehouse, a pin floats over what to do next, one thing at a time: on your first night the dressing stations, then 🎶 the decks; 🎁 something new you've found until you've been to it; 🧭 the map table when there's somewhere new to sail; 💤 the bed after a lost night
Your very first night has no pile of last night's clothes by the bed: you dress at the wardrobe, shoe rack, cloak pegs, bags and hats, and the pins show the way

changes.title: Stations on e
items: The treehouse's menus open when you press E (□ on a pad, a tap on touch) at the wardrobe, mirrors, shoe rack, pegs, bags, Workshop, map table, telescope and the Studio's instruments, instead of opening as you walk up; E again closes them, the instruments too
While one's open she stays put: the movement keys move around the menu, look round through the telescope and pick islands on the chart; Space (✕ on a pad) chooses
Whatever you can use lights up with a warm outline as you come near, with a little key showing the button over it (a round one on a pad); her decks glow too while E there starts the party

changes.title: Wake keys
items: Waking up, the keys stand beside the bed: WASD on its left to get up, E and "snooooze" on its right (the left stick and □ on a controller)
